= Transformer reference corpus

52 bibitems harvested from the metanorma-ietf model-driven
transformer's spec suite and document fixtures
(https://github.com/metanorma/metanorma-ietf, branch
`feat/model-driven-transformer` — the
https://github.com/metanorma/metanorma-ietf/issues/233[#233] QA
campaign), deduplicated by content digest, plus four synthetic items
covering shapes the suite lacked: an English monograph with two
authors and a page extent, a Greek monograph (non-Latin author and
publisher), a journal article with volume/issue/pages, and an ISSN
journal item with a numbered series.

Filenames are `<key>-<source id>.xml`; the key preserves the harvest
order used in the differential review of PR #125.

`transformer_corpus_spec.rb` runs each through
`Item.from_xml → Converter::BibXml.from_item(v3: true)` and asserts
the structural sentinels distilled from that review (no crashes on
parse-built items, no deprecated `<format>`, no publisher/authorizer
organization-authors, text-only titles, deduplicated seriesInfo, no
degenerate `ascii*` remainders of non-Latin folding, clean
abstracts). They are deliberately not golden files: open rendering
choices stay open; only the fixed defect classes are pinned.
